canonical_claim.template: Within the 2025 Cleveland, OH metro record, the FHA denial-rate spread between major lenders was {value} percentage points.

required_qualifiers.universe: high-volume lenders within the Cleveland metro
required_qualifiers.nature: derived statistic, not in raw HMDA

does_not_establish: every pair of Cleveland lenders differs by 73.7 points
the spread applies to other metros or years
rule: Free text is the OUTPUT of evidence, not its input. Certify before you write.
